notes.title: New Language - Chinese Now Available
notes.content: The game has been updated to include new language options for Chinese.

notes.title: Dead End Aegis is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
JAST is excited to announce that [i]Dead End Aegis[/i] has arrived on Steam! 

We're incredibly proud to offer this genre-defying visual novel on Steam, and sincerely hope you all enjoy it as much as we have! Be sure to follow us here on Steam to stay up to date with JAST goings-on! And if you really want to stay in the loop, our [url=discord.gg/rMGjzQE]discord[/url] is very chatty and very fun! We've got a great community, and we'd love to see you there.

If you haven't experienced the prequel yet, [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839960/Dead_End_Aegis_Gaiden/]Dead End Aegis: Gaiden[/url][/i], you can play it for free here on Steam!
